profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with a passion for creating accessible user experiences that are scalable, sustainable, and focus on solving user problems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Spearheaded the engineering effort to convert lovepop.com to a headless e-commerce solution using NextJS and Vercel, halving Time To Interactive.
• Coordinated with an agency as the primary point of contact during the conversion to a headless solution, aligning engineers on requirements, process and deliverables.
• Improved accessibility for lovepop.com by acquiring professional education for the broader team, successfully training 9 designers and engineers, incorporating accessibility in all new features, and planning the refactoring of legacy features.
• Represented the engineering team both as a squad lead and tech lead in communications with stakeholders to coordinate, advise and deliver on roadmap initiatives.
• Managed the roadmap for the remediation and mitigation of technical debt, focusing on improving security, accessibility, documentation, unit testing, code quality, and developer happiness.
• Coached and mentored peers on topics including approach to problem solving, interpersonal conflict and career paths.
• Led team retrospectives, sprint planning and grooming sessions, and actively participated in the cultivation of team process and culture.

positions.title: Front-end Engineer
positions.description:
• Built responsive features using React, Redux and test-driven development.
• Created and updated endpoints in the back-end using .NET to retrieve data for the front-end. 
• Followed the Pivotal process, participating in agile ceremonies and daily pair programming.

positions.title: Enterprise Advisor (UX Development Specialist)
positions.description:
• Developed responsive AngularJS components compatible with new and legacy applications within multiple codebases and tech stacks.  
• Led the front-end development effort on projects with accelerated timelines, overseeing code quality and managing expectations with the broader team. 
• Coordinated front-end handoffs with remote back-end teams, documenting and presenting the code and final experience with each deliverable.

positions.title: Interactive Developer L1
positions.description:
• Implemented responsive web applications for various clients across diverse tech stacks, creating custom interactive components most notably in AngularJS, React Native, Backbone, ES5 and jQuery.  
• Architected an agnostic JS framework that stored user state and interactions throughout a web application and sent data to a third-party analytics tool.  
• Designed a Rest API for managing QA test cases on a React Native app.
• Prototyped a physical security system that automatically unlocked for approaching, authorized mobile users using PhoneGap and Beacon technology.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: • Designed, developed, and tested new mobile pages and mobile web enhancements.

positions.title: Mobile Web Design Intern
positions.description:
• Designed assets and user interfaces for two mobile apps.
• Designed a logo and college recruitment posters for the GEICO mobile team.
• Developed two Adobe AIR mobile apps.
• Created landing pages and small web applications for mobile use.
